fonts.display: 'Arial', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Legquinne VF', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Burnt Wine
palette.role: Footer background, sectional dark bands, atmospheric accent — the sole chromatic note in an otherwise achromatic palette, used sparingly to anchor gravity

palette.name: Ink Stone
palette.role: Primary text, hairline borders, image frames, nav links — the structural near-black that defines every edge and label

palette.name: Warm Parchment
palette.role: Dominant page canvas, section backgrounds, card surfaces — warm stone tone that gives the site its gallery-like, hand-made feel

palette.name: White
palette.role: Elevated surfaces, inverted text on dark sections, nav text over imagery, subtle highlight washes
